comparison.objective: Hot-swap a failed drive sled and insert a spare; candidate extracts a connector terminal.
comparison.physical_skill: Hold an external latch button while pulling a large sled, then align and insert a replacement versus recessed dual-blade tang release and wire withdrawal.
comparison.success_condition: Failed sled removed, spare seated and latched, healthy sleds undisturbed versus only the selected terminal removed and connector preserved.
comparison.reason: Release-and-pull is shared abstractly, but the drive task is gross bay service and replacement insertion; it does not test fine tool-around-contact access or dual-tang depression.
